api: YouTube Analytics API v2 + YouTube Reporting API v1
scope: Official public Google discovery documents re-audited for YouTube Analytics API v2 (revision 20260729, 8 operations) and YouTube Reporting API v1 (revision 20260729, 8 operations). JSON resources are covered by typed streams/write actions where the declarative engine can safely execute them. Provider ad-hoc reports.query and report-byte media download remain blocked operation metadata because they require shared direct-query/binary executor work.

operation.reason: Official reports.query returns ad-hoc tabular QueryResponse data across the separate youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com host. Executable direct-read commands currently require a narrowly typed provider-query operation with bounded output policy and no raw-query escape hatch; keep blocked pending shared provider-query/direct-read foundation (#2985).

Official media.download returns generated report bytes at /v1/media/{+resourceName}?alt=media. This is not JSON metadata and is intentionally not modeled as a stream; keep blocked until a bounded binary file-download executor with destination path safety, size limits, digest/audit evidence, and explicit approval exists.
